newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.52 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.52 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.675 to the dollar after Tuesday's fixing at 26.368, and at 17.623 to the mark from 17.537.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +3.52 percent, compared with a deviation of +4.21 on Tuesday.
During the minute the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown traded on the interbank market at +3.50.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
